youtube.description:
Vibe coding vs spec-driven development: 5 differences (Kiro)

Vibe coding versus spec coding. Five differences that matter.

1. The start - A prompt, then code. Spec coding starts with requirements.
2. The plan - The plan lives in your head. Spec coding writes it down in design.md.
3. The progress - Progress is a long chat scroll. Spec coding tracks it in tasks.md.
4. The rules - You retype the rules every prompt. Spec coding keeps them in steering files.
5. The handoff - Only the author knows why. Spec coding leaves docs your team can read.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/
